newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MAGIC ACTIVATE HARDAWAY, WAIVE KENNY SMITH.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MAGIC ACTIVATE HARDAWAY, WAIVE KENNY SMITH.

text.p: The Orlando Magic, nose-diving with 13 losses in their last 16 games, got a much-needed lift Monday when they activated two-time All-Star guard Penny Hardaway from the injured list.

To make room for Hardaway, the Magic waived guard Kenny Smith, who they signed when they placed Hardaway on the injured list back on December 18. Orlando (11-17) went 2-9 during Hardaway's second stint on the injured list.
The Magic are 7-16 without Hardaway this season.

Hardaway's most recent stop on the injured list was due to tendinitis in his knee. The lanky playmaker had arthroscopic surgery on his left knee in November to repair torn cartilage. He is averaging 20.2 points, 5.8 assists and 5.8 rebounds per game.
Other good news may be in store for the Magic.

Shooting guard Nick Anderson, who has missed Orlando's last 15 games with an injured right wrist, began working out Sunday. Both players are listed as probable for Tuesday's home game against Philadelphia.
